stage.note: No accelerator found; https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/steel returns a 404 (not a YC company). Third-party aggregator StartupHub.ai lists a '$17M Series A led by Felicis Ventures, 22 Mar 2025' for 'Steel.dev', but that figure/date/lead exactly match TechCrunch's confirmed report of a $17M SEED round led by Felicis (Astasia Myers) for a DIFFERENT company, 'Browser Use' (browser-use.com), announced 2025-03-23 — i.e. the aggregator appears to have conflated two different 'browser automation for AI agents' startups. No primary source (company blog, press release, or reputable press specifically about Steel.dev/steel-dev) confirming any funding round, amount, investor, or date was found in the time available, so funding stage/amount/investors are left unknown rather than repeating the apparently-misattributed aggregator number.

note: Independent, venture-backed-looking startup (not a YC company despite superficial similarity of concept to other YC 'browser for agents' startups; the YC companies page for the 'steel' slug 404s). Co-founded by Hussien Hussien (CEO) and Nasr Mohamed (CTO), per Fly.io customer story (2024-09-25) and GitHub (github.com/hussufo, github.com/fukouda); LinkedIn shows the company founded 2024 with 11-50 employees. Public beta product launched via 'Show HN' in Nov 2024. Funding: could not confirm any round from a primary source within the research window; the only funding figure found ($17M Series A led by Felicis, 22 Mar 2025, via StartupHub.ai) is very likely a data-conflation with the unrelated startup 'Browser Use', which raised a confirmed $17M SEED round led by the same Felicis partner on the same date (per TechCrunch) — a buyer should treat that $17M figure as NOT reliably attributable to Steel.dev. No shutdown/pivot/acquisition signals found; product is actively shipping (frequent blog posts/launches through Sept 2026).
